title: Refund Ledger Standard — Charge Components on a Guest Cancellation
content:
# Charge components on a guest-cancellation refund

This ledger standard governs how each charge component of a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category is refunded and booked when the guest cancels.

## Clauses in force

- **Cleaning fee.** The cleaning fee is refunded in full on any standard-rate cancellation dated before the check-in date when the policy refunds it before check-in, and on a cancellation on or after the check-in date only when the policy refunds it after check-in.
- **Occupancy tax.** Occupancy tax is refunded in the proportion that the refunded occupancy-tax base bears to the full occupancy-tax base.
- **Once per component.** A guest-cancellation refund for the same stay and the same charge component is issued only once. Whether one has been issued is read from the refund entries on that stay's ledger with the guest-cancellation reason for that component.
- **Funding.** Nightly, cleaning, pet and extra-guest refunds are funded by the host; guest service fee and occupancy tax refunds are funded by the platform.
- **Zero amounts.** A component whose refund comes to 0.00 posts no entry.

## Clauses no longer in force

Each of the following former clauses is no longer in force as worded; it has been superseded by the current basis:

- that the pet fee and extra-guest fee are refunded in the same proportion as the nightly subtotal when the policy's setting says so;
- that outside the full-refund window and grace period the guest service fee is refunded in the proportion that the refunded service-fee base bears to the full service-fee base when the policy's setting is proportional, and not at all when it is none, always subject to the guest service fee refund cap;
- that for each component the refund posted is the lesser of the amount of that component collected so far and the amount refundable under this rule;
- that installments not yet collected are cancelled and never collected.

## Component table

| Charge component | Treatment in force | Funded by |
|---|---|---|
| Nightly | by the cancellation windows of the stay's policy | host |
| Cleaning fee | in full before check-in when the policy says so; on or after check-in only when the policy says so | host |
| Pet fee | former proportional clause no longer in force (superseded by the current basis) | host |
| Extra-guest fee | former proportional clause no longer in force (superseded by the current basis) | host |
| Guest service fee | in full in the grace period or full-refund window when the policy says so; former clause for other cancellations no longer in force (superseded by the current basis) | platform |
| Occupancy tax | in the proportion of the refunded occupancy-tax base to the full occupancy-tax base | platform |

## Worked proportion (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical stay was charged 150.00 of occupancy tax on an occupancy-tax base of 1,000.00. If the amounts refunded within that base come to 400.00, the occupancy tax refunded is 400.00 divided by 1,000.00, that is 0.4, times 150.00, which is 60.00.

## Points of judgement

- If a stay's ledger already shows a guest-cancellation refund of the cleaning fee, no second guest-cancellation refund of the cleaning fee is issued on it; a guest-cancellation refund of another component is not affected.
- A refund of the same component made for a different reason, such as a host cancellation, is not a guest-cancellation refund.

superseded_clauses: installments not yet collected are cancelled and never collected
For each component the refund posted is the lesser of the amount of that component collected so far and the amount refundable under this rule
The pet fee and extra-guest fee are refunded in the same proportion as the nightly subtotal when add_on_fees_follow_nightly is true.

Outside the full-refund window and grace period the guest service fee is refunded in the proportion that the refunded service-fee base bears to the full service-fee base when service_fee_partial_refund_mode is proportional, and not at all when it is none, always subject to stay_agg_service_fee_refund_cap.
